platform.name: ASMR & SAMR Admin Console
platform.summary: Supabase-backed operations console for ASMR & SAMR ecommerce, inventory, production, finance, marketing, customer, and system administration.

stack.jobs: Supabase/Postgres operations; no queue framework detected
stack.designSystem: Custom ASMR & SAMR luxury design system

qualityGates.rationale: The static Cloudflare deployment package builds successfully.
The browser application is vanilla JavaScript and has no configured typecheck task.
No linter is configured; both modified browser bundles pass JavaScript syntax checks.
All locally available dashboard, storefront, security, and packaging gates pass.

qualityGates.threshold: Critical role workflows pass in a real browser
evidence: Owner profile update succeeded against the live admin-users Edge Function
Product create dialog verified with integrated photo picker at desktop and mobile widths
Settings General route and customer account direct links verified
qualityGates.rationale: Critical requested workflows passed in the signed-in in-app browser.

qualityGates.threshold: WCAG target and keyboard checks pass
evidence: Dialog focus, Escape, labels, and responsive contracts pass automated checks
qualityGates.rationale: A complete screen-reader and keyboard-only audit of every dashboard module remains outstanding.

qualityGates.threshold: Authorization, tenant, and high-risk action checks pass
evidence: python website/test_admin_authenticated.py: 20 passed in prior authenticated run
qualityGates.rationale: Static policy checks and the authenticated owner workflow pass; anonymous live probes were unavailable during the final local run.
Production-volume budgets and realistic data volumes have not been defined.

gaps.description: The hidden users route can be opened directly by non-admin roles with customers.read, and profiles RLS permits those roles to select all profiles.
gaps.rationale: Navigation hiding is not authorization; this can expose staff and customer profile data beyond the intended role boundary.

gaps.description: Dashboard exports are downloaded before the audit event is attempted, and audit insertion failures are swallowed.
gaps.rationale: Regulated exports must be auditable and should fail closed when the audit record cannot be persisted.

gaps.description: CSV export escaping does not neutralize cells beginning with spreadsheet formula control characters.
gaps.rationale: User-controlled names, descriptions, notes, and contact fields can become executable formulas when an export is opened in spreadsheet software.

gaps.description: safeRows converts all request failures into empty arrays across operational dashboards.
gaps.rationale: Authorization, schema, and availability failures can be misrepresented as zero sales, zero stock, or no records instead of a degraded/error state.

gaps.description: Admin modals set initial focus but do not trap focus, restore the opener, or implement Escape-to-close behavior.
gaps.rationale: Critical edit and confirmation workflows are not fully keyboard operable against the WCAG 2.2 AA target.

gaps.description: Product photos were managed only after product creation in a separate workflow.
gaps.rationale: Operators need one product-creation flow that preserves the product even when a later image upload fails.

gaps.description: The Settings footer action opened Shipping Methods instead of a complete settings control surface.
gaps.rationale: Settings must provide clear entry points for account, commerce, security, and system controls.

gaps.description: The admin Profile action exposed account information without edit, recovery, or activity controls.
gaps.rationale: Administrators need an authorized self-service workflow for profile maintenance and account recovery.

gaps.description: Customer profile, wishlist, notification preferences, and local order history are stored in the browser rather than a signed-in Supabase customer account.
gaps.rationale: Account data does not follow customers across devices and cannot yet support reliable self-service history or unified support operations.
